commands: echo '--- build context root (is this a clean checkout?) ---'; ls -la
echo '--- stale dirs in build context ---'; ls -d out bin obj 2>/dev/null || echo 'none'
echo '--- stray assemblies in build context ---'; find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.dll' -not -path './obj/*' -not -path './bin/*' -not -path './out/*' | head -20; true
echo '--- Program.cs being built ---'; head -12 Program.cs
echo -n 'Program.cs fingerprint: '; md5sum Program.cs; echo -n 'CreateUmbracoBuilder is on line: '; grep -n CreateUmbracoBuilder Program.cs | head -1
echo -n 'CsvHelper entries in deps.json (expect 0): '; grep -o '"CsvHelper[^"]*"' out/NDSTK.deps.json | sort -u | wc -l
echo -n 'Umbraco.Forms entries in deps.json (expect 0): '; grep -o '"Umbraco.Forms[^"]*"' out/NDSTK.deps.json | sort -u | wc -l
echo -n 'stray Forms/Csv files in out/ (expect 0): '; ls out | grep -icE 'forms|csvhelper'; true
